ra: The LaVeyan symbolic Satan is the central figure of the Church of Satan, the founding body of organized modern Satanism.
The Four Crown Princes are a doctrinal/ritual grouping of the Church of Satan within the modern Satanism movement.
Theistic Satanism's worshipped Satan belongs to the broad modern Satanism movement as its devotional/literalist current.
Luciferianism is a recognized current within the modern Satanism movement.
The Temple of Set's Set is the focal deity of the Setian current, a schismatic offshoot within organized modern Satanism.
Satan is the first of LaVey's Four Crown Princes of Hell (south, fire); wiring the existing Satan entity into the collective rather than recreating it.
Lucifer is named by LaVey as a Crown Prince of Hell (east, air); existing Lucifer entity wired into the collective.
Belial is named by LaVey as a Crown Prince of Hell (north, earth); existing Belial entity wired into the collective.
Leviathan is named by LaVey as a Crown Prince of Hell (west, water); existing Leviathan entity wired into the collective.
The LaVeyan symbolic adversary is a modern reinterpretation of the biblical/Second-Temple Satan, stripped of literal existence and recast as the carnal self.
Theistic Satanism's worshipped Satan is a devotional reception of the biblical/Second-Temple adversary as a literal deity.
The Luciferian light-bringer is a positive modern reception of the Christian-reception Lucifer, inverting the fallen-angel narrative into one of enlightenment.
The Temple of Set venerates the Egyptian god Set/Seth as a real divine intelligence; Aquino's Setian Set is a modern reception of the ancient Egyptian deity.
The Sigil of Baphomet (goat's-head pentagram) derived from Lévi's Baphomet is the emblem of the Church of Satan and broader modern Satanism.
LaVey adopted Lévi's Baphomet as the iconographic Sigil of Baphomet representing Satan in Church of Satan ritual.
The Temple of Set defined itself in schism from the Church of Satan (1975), rejecting LaVey's purely symbolic Satan in favor of a literal deity Set; doctrinal opposition between the two currents.
